summary: Clas Ohlson AB (publ), a retail company, sells building, electrical, multimedia, home, and leisure products in Sweden, Norway, Finland, and internationally. It also provides mobile phones; electronics spare parts and accessories; and batteries. In addition, the company provides trade services within carpentry, electrical work, and plumbing, as well as services in gardening, cleaning, etc. Further, it sells its products through its stores, online shopping channels, and purchase offices. Clas Ohlson AB (publ) was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Insjön, Sweden.
